member.summary: Gets the number of characters read since the beginning of the current row.
member.remarks: This is a character position, not the index of the field being read. It counts every character consumed by the current row, including the characters of a multi-line quoted value, and it is reset to 0 at the start of each row.

member.name: P:Meziantou.Framework.Csv.CsvReader.LineNumber
member.summary: Gets the number of line terminators consumed so far.
member.remarks: This is 0 while the first line is being read, and is incremented as each line ends. Line terminators inside a quoted value are counted, so this tracks the physical line in the input rather than the number of rows returned. See for the row.
